## Objective
- Finish the existing “Nightfall” browser survival game for issue #9: top-down player-controlled shelter survival where the character restores/repairs shelter defenses, fights with a weapon, and gathers resources from creatures or the surrounding map.

## Requirements
- Overhead/top-down view with player-controlled movement/actions.
- Main actions: restore/strengthen shelter against attacks; repair shelter damage caused by creatures.
- Player has a weapon.
- Repair/strengthening resources come from creature drops or resources found outside the shelter.
- Build complete and playable; do not ask clarifying questions; note assumptions briefly at finish.

## Decisions
- Existing top-down “Nightfall” game already matches most of the request, so continue/refine it rather than rebuilding.
- Gated enemy spawning to night because daytime spawns were attacking the shelter during daylight.
- Added wood/stone drops from creatures so creature loot can contribute to repairs/fortification, not just scrap.
- Added `R` as a keyboard repair shortcut and documented it in HUD/menu controls.
- Added a favicon to eliminate the persistent `/favicon.ico` 404 console error.
- Increased frame `dt` cap from `0.05` to `0.1` to reduce game-time slowdown on low-FPS devices.
- Reworked mobile portrait/landscape HUD positions to remove major overlaps; hid the empty companion panel on mobile.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected game and prior conversation history; confirmed current game is `Nightfall`, top-down with shelters, fortification, repair, weapon, resource nodes and companion mechanics.
- Verified game loads without console errors after favicon fix.
- Verified Start, claim shelter, gather wood, fortify, shelter damage from enemies, repair via panel and `R`, night entry, dawn screen, and health damage from enemies using temporary debug hooks.
- Fixed daytime enemy spawning in `updateSpawning`.
- Added varied creature resource drops in `killEnemy`.
- Added `R` repair handling and UI hints.
- Added mobile layout fixes in `styles.css` for portrait and landscape.
- Restored normal durations (`DAY_DURATION = 80`, `DUSK_DURATION = 12`, `NIGHT_BASE = 46`) and removed the temporary `window.__nf` debug hook.
- `node --check game.js` passes.

### Active
- Final verification/polish. Latest portrait/mobile bounding-box check shows no major overlaps; mobile controls and shelter panel are usable.
- Need to run a final clean browser sanity pass and possibly inspect final diff/status.

### Blocked
- Cannot visually inspect screenshots because this model does not support image input; use DOM bounding boxes, HUD text, console output, and pixel/canvas checks instead.
- Headless Chromium is slow enough that full 80s day / 46s night waits are impractical; temporary short durations were used, then restored.

## Next Move
1. Reload final game and verify no console errors and normal HUD values in desktop + portrait + landscape.
2. Run `node --check game.js`; inspect `git diff` to ensure only intended changes remain (no debug hook/temp constants).
3. Optionally capture final screenshots for artifacts only.
4. Stop/clean up the tmux server session `nightfall` and Playwright browser if appropriate.
5. Report completion with brief assumptions/controls summary.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: Main game logic; contains all mechanics and recent fixes.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: HUD/menu markup; updated controls text, story copy, favicon.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: HUD styling; mobile/landscape layout fixes at the end and in responsive media blocks.

### What changed
- **Daylight is now safe for scavenging** — enemies only spawn at night.
- **Creature drops now include wood and stone** as well as scrap, so kills directly help repairs and fortification.
- **Added `R` as a repair shortcut**, with the control documented in the HUD and main menu.

- Added an inline favicon to remove the persistent `/favicon.ico` 404.

- `node --check game.js` passes.
